RawComment: The lecturer was excellent and explained complex concepts clearly. I really enjoyed this course.
The professor ignored my emails three times and refused to give feedback on my assignment. Very disappointing service.
As a non-native English speaker, I found the technical terminology very difficult to understand. Please provide a glossary for future courses.
The course materials contain outdated stereotypes about mental health conditions. This is harmful to students with these conditions.
The examples only featured male programmers and the language assumes the reader is male. This is discouraging for female students.
The assignment assumed everyone celebrates Christmas, which doesn't respect my cultural background as a Buddhist student.
All the website links in the course materials are broken. I can't access any of the required readings.
I contacted support about enrollment issues but they transferred me to three different departments. Nobody knew how to help me.
The lab sessions were well-organized and the teaching assistant was knowledgeable and helpful. Great experience overall.
The administrative staff never processed my extension request despite multiple follow-ups. I'm very dissatisfied with this service.
The audio recordings are very fast and use slang that international students wouldn't know. Please make them more accessible.
The case studies about trauma could be triggering for students who have experienced similar situations. There should be warnings.
The professor kept referring to engineers as 'he' and 'him' throughout the course. This is outdated and exclusionary language.
The assessment assumes Western cultural perspectives and doesn't acknowledge Indigenous knowledge systems or viewpoints.
The learning platform has poor contrast and tiny text that makes it almost impossible to read for long periods.
I needed help with my clinical placement but was repeatedly directed to academic advisors who couldn't assist with placement issues.
The textbook has numerous errors in the diagrams which made learning the concepts much more difficult than necessary.
During group discussions, my contributions were repeatedly ignored while male students' similar ideas were praised by the tutor.
I have anxiety and the sudden pop quizzes without warning caused me severe stress. Please announce assessments in advance.
The lecture was perfect and the material was presented at just the right pace with excellent examples and clear explanations.
